note: Company layer (policy UNSEEN-U15). The case keeps the payroll as it was before the PKB (old salary, premiums as billed); the policy recomputes base salary and BPJS amounts from April 2027 with the regulation's rates and caps, and pays the back amounts in April as irregular income. JHT/JP back contributions are deducted in April.
